He moved to Chelsea in 1964 and then to Arsenal in 1966, where he became an immediate regular and top scorer.

milestone_by_age_26: His first acknowledged work, 'Variazioni canoniche sulla serie dell'op. 41 di A. Schönberg,' was premiered at the Darmstädter Ferienkurse on August 27, 1950, conducted by Hermann Scherchen, establishing Nono as a significant new voice in the European avant-garde at age 26.
early_history_summary: Nono was born in Venice to a wealthy artistic family; his grandfather was a notable painter. He began music lessons with Gian Francesco Malipiero at the Venice Conservatory in 1941, studying Renaissance madrigal tradition. He also earned a law degree from the University of Padua. Through Bruno Maderna, he met Hermann Scherchen, who became his mentor and premiered his first work at Darmstadt in 1950. Nono had been a member of the Italian Resistance during WWII.
family_context_summary: Born in Venice to a wealthy artistic family; his grandfather was a notable painter. The family's wealth and artistic environment provided early access to cultural education.
parent_family_domain_summary: Grandfather was a notable painter. The family was wealthy and artistically oriented, providing early immersion in the arts.
primary_early_advantage_tags: Venice Conservatory, Darmstadt, Malipiero, Maderna, Scherchen, wealthy artistic family, Italian Resistance, avant-garde
evidence_summary: Nono's path was shaped by his wealthy artistic family in Venice, which provided access to the Venice Conservatory where he studied with Gian Francesco Malipiero from age 17. His law degree from the University of Padua gave him broader intellectual grounding. The critical catalyst was his mentorship network: Bruno Maderna introduced him to Hermann Scherchen, who premiered his first work at the Darmstadt Ferienkurse in 1950 at age 26. Darmstadt was the epicenter of post-war European avant-garde music, and Nono's debut there placed him alongside Boulez and Stockhausen as a leader of the New Music movement. His WWII resistance experience shaped his political commitment, which distinguished his work from peers.
